# CareerHunt

CareerHunt is a careers and jobs platform focused on helping job seekers discover opportunities in the UAE, the US, and other global markets.

## Primary site sections
- [Home](https://careerhunt.online/)
- [Job listings](https://careerhunt.online/jobs)
- [Companies](https://careerhunt.online/companies)
- [Job categories](https://careerhunt.online/categories)
- [Countries and locations](https://careerhunt.online/countries)
- [Salary guide](https://careerhunt.online/salary-guide)
- [Career resources](https://careerhunt.online/career-resources)
- [Career insights](https://careerhunt.online/career-insights)
- [About](https://careerhunt.online/about)
- [Contact](https://careerhunt.online/contact)

## Key content themes
- UAE and international job opportunities
- Employer and company profiles
- Career guides, visa information, and salary resources
- Recent job postings and category-based browsing

## Recommended crawl priorities
1. [Job listings](https://careerhunt.online/jobs)
2. [Job categories](https://careerhunt.online/categories)
3. [Countries and locations](https://careerhunt.online/countries)
4. [Salary guide](https://careerhunt.online/salary-guide)
5. [Career resources](https://careerhunt.online/career-resources)
6. [About](https://careerhunt.online/about)
7. [Contact](https://careerhunt.online/contact)

## Notes
- The site is optimized for job discovery and career guidance.
- Dynamic job pages are generated from the main jobs listing and company/category taxonomy.
